evidence.title: Anti-Israel groups rally across US on October 7 anniversary, chanting 'long live the intifada'

occurrences.checkable_against: People's Forum and Shut it Down 4 Palestine social media posts
occurrences.quote_span: On Tuesday, the People’s Forum collaborated with Shut it Down 4 Palestine to prepare for a separate protest that will take place on Saturday in Washington Square Park "to stand against three years of continued genocide in Gaza," according to their social media post.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anti-Israel organizations

occurrences.checkable_against: Columbia University security and demonstration records
occurrences.quote_span: Separately, anti-Israel demonstrators arrived at the gates of Columbia University at 2 p.m., where encampments and riots embattled the campus for years after Oct. 7, 2023.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anti-Israel organizations

occurrences.checkable_against: Israel Healing Initiative organizational records and trauma-treatment program records
occurrences.quote_span: Trauma psychologist Dr. Orli Peter, who founded the Israel Healing Initiative, a nonprofit that has been providing high-tech trauma treatment for people impacted by the Oct. 7 attack, told Fox News Digital that the demonstrations across the country "manipulate the public," weaponize the anniversary, and detract from the mourning of Jewish people.
occurrences.speaker: Dr. Orli Peter

occurrences.checkable_against: UC Davis demonstration records and video

occurrences.checkable_against: NYU Students for Justice in Palestine social media posts and event records
occurrences.quote_span: At 12:30 p.m., organizers from the NYU Students for Justice in Palestine staged a walkout in Washington Square Park as part of their "NYU WEEK OF RAGE," where they said in a social media post they remain "steadfast in our commitment to Palestinian liberation."

occurrences.subject: Anti-Israel organizations

occurrences.checkable_against: UCLA campus demonstration records
occurrences.quote_span: In California, Students for Justice in Palestine UCLA mobilized at Bruin Plaza on the Los Angeles campus, echoing similar messages to separate groups across the country.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anti-Israel organizations

occurrences.checkable_against: demonstration organizer announcements and event records
occurrences.quote_span: A number of demonstrations took place in New York, California and other states – with nonprofits in the Singham network organizing and staging larger rallies set for this weekend, intentionally scheduled on and around the anniversary of the Hamas terrorist attack.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anti-Israel organizations

occurrences.checkable_against: New York City Hall security and demonstration records
occurrences.quote_span: At 4 p.m., some of the same groups who were protesting at Columbia traveled to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s office at City Hall, with Palestinian flags flying and chants echoing throughout the Financial District of Manhattan.
